import { IconSearch } from "@tabler/icons-react"
import { Empty, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle } from "@/components/ui/empty"

export const title = "Try Different Keywords"

const Example = () => (
  <Empty>
    <EmptyHeader>
      <EmptyMedia>
        <IconSearch className="size-8 text-muted-foreground" />
      </EmptyMedia>
      <EmptyTitle>No results for your search</EmptyTitle>
      <EmptyDescription>
        Try using different keywords or check the spelling. You can also browse our categories to find what you're
        looking for.
      </EmptyDescription>
    </EmptyHeader>
  </Empty>
)

export default Example
